tasks.label: Restart Backend (8080)
tasks.command: pids=$(lsof -ti :8080 || true); if [[ -n "$pids" ]]; then printf '%s\n' "$pids" | xargs kill -9; fi; cd "${workspaceFolder}" && mvn -f app/pom.xml spring-boot:run

tasks.label: Rebuild + Restart Backend (8080)
tasks.command: pids=$(lsof -ti :8080 || true); if [[ -n "$pids" ]]; then printf '%s\n' "$pids" | xargs kill -9; fi; cd "${workspaceFolder}" && mvn -f app/pom.xml clean package && mvn -f app/pom.xml spring-boot:run

tasks.label: Restart Web Dev (5173)
tasks.command: pids=$(lsof -ti :5173 || true); if [[ -n "$pids" ]]; then printf '%s\n' "$pids" | xargs kill -9; fi; cd "${workspaceFolder}/web" && npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort

tasks.label: Build + Preview Web (4173)
tasks.command: pids=$(lsof -ti :4173 || true); if [[ -n "$pids" ]]; then printf '%s\n' "$pids" | xargs kill -9; fi; cd "${workspaceFolder}/web" && npm run build && npm run preview -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4173 --strictPort
